query.text:
delete from public.exclusive_content e
  where e.id = p_content_id
    and e.creator_id = auth.uid()
    and e.created_at > now() - interval '15 minutes'
    and not exists (
      select 1 from public.content_purchases p where p.content_id = e.id
    )
